text:
morgan: quick thought - we need a small replay API for fallback tokens so support/QA can repro the exact decision without exporting prompts. idea: GET /internal/fallbacks/{token}/replay returns the decision tuple + redacted_preview + deterministic inputs used.
arya: must be gated and auditable. add who-triggered and replay_ts to the audit row. we should also show a tiny UI button "replay in sandbox" that streams the chosen variant output for local inspection.
devin: implementation: replay should accept a mode param: dry-run (return what would have happened) vs live-replay (actually run the model). live-replay must only be allowed with internal keys and should be rate-limited.
srinivas: security: redact PII by default. replay payload returns prompt_hash, prompt_preview (first 80 chars) and a re-derivation seed so engineers can reproduce exact deterministic routing decisions. store seed in decision record but don't expose full prompt unless customer explicitly approved via consent flag.
taylor: UX: in the rollout detail, add a column "Replays" with counts. clicking opens a panel with recent tokens, a play icon, and an audit link. replay action prompts a confirmation modal that logs the actor and reason.
opsbot: deploybot: feature/fallback-replay enabled in staging at 4391234575 by ci-user.
morgan: telemetry/metrics: emit replay events into the same telemetry stream with event_type=replay and include duration and outcome. keep replay retention aligned with decision retention.
devin: QA: replay should optionally compute the quality_delta vs the original sampled output and attach a mini-report. helpful for regressions.
arya: billing question: if live-replay runs a model, we should flag it in billing exports as "internal_replay_units" and exclude from customer charge by default.
srinivas: agree. infra note: make sure replay can't be used to enumerate prompts. require token + signed ephemeral replay key and deny if token older than retention window.
morgan: ok i'll draft the minimal API spec and a tiny console mock for the replay panel and post a PR. can folks review in the 1pm sync?
arya: yes. devin/srinivas: thumbs up.
